title: IssuedCard
description: A virtual card the merchant made at SecurePay Bank, the network's issuer (v2 issuing, docs/v2/ISSUING.md). The bank checks every payment on it against its spending limit. `number` and `cvc` are in the reply that created the card only: the gateway and the bank keep neither.

livemode.description: true for a live-mode key, false for test mode.

spending_limit.description: In SGD cents, over the card's life.

spent.description: Approved and not cancelled, as the bank last reported it.

single_use.description: Used up by its first approved payment. A cancelled payment gives the use back.

number.description: The full card number. In the create reply only.

authorisations.description: On GET of one card: the bank's latest answers on it, newest first (at most 50).

response_code.description: ISO 8583 DE 39: 00 approved, 61 over the limit, 62 used or cancelled, 54 wrong or past expiry (NETWORK-CONTRACT.md section 9).
